description: Achaemenid Persian Immortals are often depicted wearing scale armor, made from many small overlapping plates of metal sewn or laced onto a flexible backing of leather or heavy cloth. Archaeological evidence and ancient descriptions suggest that bronze and iron scales were both used, especially for wealthier or elite troops. The armor typically protected the torso while remaining more flexible than a solid cuirass, making it well suited to Persian infantry who combined spear, bow, and close-combat fighting. Its shimmering, layered appearance also reinforced the elite visual identity associated with the Immortals.
requirementsTooltip: Unlocked in Empire Phase. Requires “Forging” or “Metallurgy.”
